news_cards.title: Tamil Nadu sarkar kooperative lending badhane ke liye Singapengal Entrepreneurship Credit Scheme ko badhava degi
bullets: Tamil Nadu ke Mukhyamantri C Joseph Vijay ne adhikariyon ko scheme ke tahat diya jaane wala loan 25% badhane ke nirdesh diya hai
Is scheme ke tahat kam se kam 30% loan naye sadasyon ko diya jayega
Is yojana ka uddeshya chhotey vyapariyon, kalaakaron, kisaanon aur machhuaaron ko vittiya sahayata pradaan karna hai

news_cards.title: Bihar ke Mithila Makhana ko GI tag mila, Australia ko pehli samudri khapath mili
bullets: Bihar ke Mithila Makhana ko GI tag mila hai, jiske baad isey Australia ko export kiya gaya hai
Is khapath ke liye 18 metric ton Mithila Makhana ka upyog kiya gaya hai
Is yojana se sthaniya kisaanon ko labh hoga aur unki aay badhegi

news_cards.title: Bharat sarkar ne UPI transactions par shulk lagane ka faisla nahi kiya, upbhoktaon ko muft rakha jayega
bullets: Bharat sarkar ne UPI transactions par shulk lagane ka faisla nahi kiya hai, upbhoktaon ko muft rakha jayega
UPI transactions par shulk lagane ki afwahon ko khatam kar diya gaya hai
Is faisla se upbhoktaon ko labh hoga aur digital bhugtaan ko badhava milega

news_cards.title: America ne Russian oil par pratibandh lagaane ki ghoshna ki, Bharat par kya prabhav padega
bullets: America ne Russian oil par pratibandh lagaane ki ghoshna ki hai, jiske karan Bharat par bhi prabhav pad sakta hai
Bharat ne Russian oil ki aapurti ko kam karne ka faisla kiya hai
Is faisla se Bharat ki arthvyavastha par kya prabhav padega, is par charcha ki jaa rahi hai

news_cards.title: Bharat sarkar ne videshi pratyaksh nivesh niti ko sudharne ka faisla kiya, nivesh ko badhava dena
bullets: Bharat sarkar ne videshi pratyaksh nivesh niti ko sudharne ka faisla kiya hai, jisse nivesh ko badhava mil sakta hai
Is niti ke tahat videshi kampaniyon ko Bharat mein nivesh karne ki suvidha hogi
Is yojana se Bharat ki arthvyavastha ko labh hoga aur nivesh badhega

news_cards.title: Telangana sarkar ne MCR TIMS Sanathnagar aspatal ka udghatan kiya, swasthya sevaon ko badhava milega
bullets: Telangana sarkar ne MCR TIMS Sanathnagar aspatal ka udghatan kiya hai, jisse swasthya sevaon ko badhava milega
Is aspatal mein adhunik suvidhaen uplabdh hogi
Is yojana se logon ko behtar swasthya sevaen pradan ki jaa sakenge

news_cards.title: Kerala sarkar ne Pathanamthitta mein baadh se nuksan ko kam karne ke liye yojana banayi
bullets: Kerala sarkar ne Pathanamthitta mein baadh se nuksan ko kam karne ke liye yojana banayi hai
Is yojana ke tahat baadh prabhavit kshetron mein madad ki jayegi
Is yojana se kisaanon ko labh hoga aur unki faslon ki suraksha hogi

news_cards.title: Assam sarkar ne baadh se prabhavit parivaaron ko arthik sahayata pradan ki
bullets: Assam sarkar ne baadh se prabhavit parivaaron ko arthik sahayata pradan ki hai
Is yojana ke tahat 75000 rupaye ki sahayata di jayegi
Is yojana se baadh se prabhavit logon ko labh hoga aur unki madad ki jayegi
